description: The Space event stream: the SSE vocabulary served by model-gateway at GET /v1/spaces/:space_id/events (relayed by the gateway BFF at GET /api/v1/spaces/{space_ref}/events). Frames carry ids and closed words only, never message text, titles, previews or outputs. Authored by hand with the slice that serves it; pinned by space-events.json.sha256 and scripts/tests/zdr-contract-sync.test.sh. Session Core's gRPC SpaceEvents service (proto/model_plane/v1/space_events.proto) is the source of every frame.

cursor.sse_id: Every frame that moves the position carries the cursor in the SSE id line (connected when mode is live, space_event, heartbeat, closing). cursor_too_old and error carry none.
cursor.contiguity: seq is strictly contiguous per generation. A row the subscriber may not see is sent as a hidden stub and an erased row as redacted, so the client enforces seq == last + 1 and treats any hole as a resnapshot trigger.

unknown_kind: A kind outside this registry is forwarded only as a hidden stub.

http.note: Not ZDR refusals: no entry in zdr-refusals.json. A ZDR caller or decision gets 200 connected{mode: poll_only} then closing{zdr_poll_only, reconnect: false} and no rows.

timing.lease_seconds: min(decision expiry minus 10 s, 85 to 100 s jittered)
